reconstruction.scope: Standing Timotesubani Dormition church and separate mapped brick gateway: cream/pink thin-course brick cross-domed body, stepped nave/transept/aisle gables, tall slit-window blind-arcaded drum with original turquoise geometric accents and gray slab cone/cross. Pale stone gabled porch has a true front passage and twin open side arches, simple original carved pier/rim forms. Separate gateway uses nested pointed brick arch and recessed wood leaves. St Barbara chapel, shop, monastic cells, temporary bell shelter/scaffolding, enclosure beyond gateway and landscaping remain independent host context. No copied frescoes, inscription/sculpture atlas or hidden furnished interior.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Picture/map estimates: main body lower eave6.4m, nave/transept eaves8.6m/ridges11m, drum from10m to16.6m, gray cone to20.5m and cross21.4m above local church floor. Drum radius3.0m with twelve blind round arcade bays/slits; original simple turquoise diamonds/rosettes. Porch about6.4m wide/3.2m deep, eave4.1m/ridge6.1m, front arch2.7x3.9m and twin1.05x2.7m side arches. Mapped gate12.84x5.88m envelope, front facade5.9m wide and5.8m tall with2.8x4.5m pointed opening/recessed timber leaves. Exact hidden eastern/rear articulation, doorway inventories, brick/glazed/stone ornaments and absolute heights are simplified picture/map approximations; OSM8m/part10m heights understate the dome.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original pinned standard6m Mapzen hillside ground, native paths/water and independent building records. Church and separate gateway each use a level occupied floor above sampled local envelope maximum; individually buried footprint foundations and narrow door/gate approaches meet retained ground. No monastery-wide slab, terrain flattening or ground/water cutout. Coarse DEM does not resolve paved terrace/thresholds or engineered retaining wall sections; exposed foundation depths are visualization fit. Do not infer a surveyed hillside from photographed retaining walls.
